aboutPage.openFailedHint: Copy the link and open it in your browser.

dialogDescription: Manage MailX language, appearance, notifications, sending and security.
recoveredDescription: Default settings are in use. The original file was preserved as settings.json.bak.
mailDarkModeDescription: Some messages look better on a white background.
fontHint: Separate multiple font names with commas.
fontError: Font names contain unsupported characters or exceed the allowed length or count.
remoteImagesDescription: Loading images may let the sender know you read the message.
avatarsDescription: Online lookup is required. The lookup service can learn whose messages you receive.
senderAccountDescription: When writing from a mailbox folder, use that account. From All inboxes, use the account selected here, or the first account added when following the current mailbox. Replies and forwards always use the original message’s account.
undoDescription: After confirming send, the message waits for this period. Undo from the notification to return to the composer. Turn this off to send immediately.
notificationPreviewHint: Includes sender, subject and recognized verification codes.
testNotificationHint: If no notification appears, allow MailX notifications in system settings.
appBadgeHint: Show the unread count on the app icon.
autostartHint: Start MailX automatically when you sign in to this computer.
trashVerificationMailAfterCopy: Move email to Trash after copying a code
trashVerificationMailAfterCopyHint: Applies after using Copy code in the message list, reader or system notification. Keeps the email if copying fails or no Trash folder is available; never deletes permanently.
silentStartHint: Run in the background at login. Opening MailX yourself still shows the main window. The window appears if no background entry is available.
autostartUnavailable: Configure launch at login in an installed copy of MailX.
autostartReadFailed: Could not read launch at login status
autostartSaveFailed: Could not change launch at login
autostartUnknown: The current status could not be confirmed.
autostartSystemError: Could not read or change the startup entry. Check system permissions and login startup settings, then try again.
languageHint: The language used for the app interface.
startupViewHint: The page the main window shows first.
closeBehaviorHint: Applies only to closing the main window. The minimize button keeps its system behavior.
closePromptTitle: What should happen when you close MailX?
closePromptDescription: If you keep MailX running, it will continue syncing mail, sending messages you confirmed, and receiving notifications. Reopen it from the system tray or app shortcut.
closePromptMacDescription: If you keep MailX running, it will continue syncing mail, sending messages you confirmed, and receiving notifications. Reopen the window from the Dock. Other compose windows stay open.
rememberCloseChoice: Remember my choice and do not ask again
trayUnavailable: The system tray is currently unavailable, so MailX cannot hide the window and keep running. Cancel to keep the window open, or quit the app. Your saved close preference will not change automatically.
showMenuBarIcon: Show MailX in the menu bar
showMenuBarIconHint: Adds shortcuts to open windows and quit. Hiding the icon does not stop background activity.
quitMailxHint: Save drafts and stop background mail activity until you open MailX again.
quitting: Saving drafts and waiting for sending to finish…
quitTimedOut: Quit was cancelled because drafts have not finished saving or mail is still sending. Check the compose windows or try quitting again later.
quitSaveFailedTitle: Could not finish saving before quitting
quitSaveFailedDescription: MailX has not confirmed the quit. Resolve the save error and try again. Unsaved layout changes are kept for the next save attempt.

mcpFailure.endpointInUse: The local endpoint is already in use; another MailX may be running
mcpFailure.endpointCreateFailed: The local endpoint could not be created
mcpFailure.permissionDenied: The system denied access to the endpoint or its folder
mcpFailure.discoveryWriteFailed: The connection info file could not be written
mcpFailure.tokenUnavailable: A secure token could not be generated

mcpClientsHint: Use the generic configuration below for other compatible clients.
mcpCopyFailed: Could not copy the client configuration
mcpToggleFailed: Could not change the MCP server setting
mcpConfirmAccess: External programs can read mail and drafts from all accounts, create, edit and delete drafts, manage attachments, and send mail without per-message confirmation.
mcpConfirmLimits: MailX attempts to sync read and starred flags to the server; archiving stays on this device. Mail cannot be deleted.
mcpConfirmLocal: Programs running as your system user can connect, read local files to attach, and export mail attachments to this device.
mcpConfirmOff: You can turn it off here at any time.
contactsGroupedDescription: Mail from these contacts shows as one row in your inbox. Open it to see everything. Right-click a message to add someone.
translationServiceDescription: Message text is sent to the service you choose.
translationModelDescription: The model that translates your mail.
translationModelNeedsSetup: Add a provider and pick a model in AI settings
translationFreeGoogle: No sign-up or key needed. Usually needs a proxy in mainland China.
translationKeyDescription: Get it from the service's website. It isn't shown again after saving.
translationRegionDescription: The region you picked when creating the translation resource. Leave empty for a global resource.
translationRegionInvalid: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
translationTestDescription: Translates a sample sentence to check that it works.
translationTestDescriptionFree: Translates a sample sentence to check that it works.
translationNetworkDescription: Used only for translation; your mail accounts aren't affected.
translationProxyInvalid: Enter the proxy address and a port from 1 to 65535.
translationProxyUserDescription: Only if your proxy requires you to sign in.
translationProxyPasswordNeedsUser: Enter a username first; a password is only used together with one.
translationSuggestDescription: Offer to translate messages that aren't in your language.
translationNeverDescription: No translation notice for messages in these languages.
translationAlwaysDescription: Translate messages in these languages when you open them.
translationSavedDescription: Kept on this device, so they open instantly next time.
aiDefaultModelDescription: AI features use it by default.
aiModelSearch: Search or type a model ID
aiModelListingUnsupported: This connection does not provide a model list.
aiModelCatalogUnverified: Presets aren’t verified on this connection.
aiNetworkDescription: Only for AI. Mail accounts are not affected.
aiKeyPlaceholderLocal: Can stay empty for local services
aiKeyWillClear: The key is cleared when you save
singleKeyShortcutsHint: Handle mail with a single key, like E to archive or S to star. Turn this off if you use voice input or assistive tools, to avoid accidental actions.
singleKeyShortcutsOff: Single-key shortcuts are off. Shortcuts with a modifier key and Esc still work.
assistantEnabledDescription: When off, there are no AI summaries or chats.
assistantAccountsDescription: The assistant only sees the ticked mailboxes.
assistantAiDraftsDescription: Changing or deleting drafts the AI wrote itself.
assistantSendDirectHint: The AI can send mail without asking.
assistantInstructionsDescription: How to address you, tone, signature habits. Added to every request.
assistantReadHtml: Let the assistant read mail formatting
assistantReadHtmlDescription: Off, it reads the text only, losing tables and where pictures sat; on, it reads the message's HTML structure, which sends much more of it.
assistantSaveHistoryDescription: Kept on this computer and shown in History.
composeOpenModeDescription: Where new mail, replies, forwards and continued drafts open. Shift-click to use the other place once.
quitInlineDraftFailed: The message being written in the main window couldn't be saved.
mcpClientLabelsHint: These names are reported by the clients themselves.
mcpAgentsHint: Add MailX to a client on this computer. Adding a configuration does not turn on the server or mean the client is connected.
mcpAgentLocalHint: Uses your personal client configuration. Reload the client after setup.
mcpAgentDeeplinkHint: Finish importing in {{name}}, then check the connected clients above.
mcpAgentManualHint: An official automatic setup method has not been confirmed. Copy the configuration snippet and consult the client documentation.
mcpAgentUnavailableHint: Automatic setup is unavailable here. Copy the configuration to set up the client manually.

mcpSetupOutcome.configured: Configuration added. Reload the client to connect.
mcpSetupOutcome.unchanged: The configuration is already up to date. Reload the client if it is not connected.
mcpSetupOutcome.handoff: Import opened in the client. Finish its confirmation to connect.
mcpSetupOutcome.conflict: The configuration changed. Check it before replacing anything.
mcpSetupOutcome.unavailable: Automatic setup is unavailable. Use the copied configuration instead.
mcpSetupOutcome.removed: MailX configuration removed. Reload the client to disconnect.

mcpDiagnosticsHint: Checks the MailX bridge and tool list without reading mail. A successful check does not mean an agent is connected.

mcpDiagnostic.ready: MailX is ready. Reload your agent if it has not connected.
mcpDiagnostic.disabled: Turn on the MCP server above, then check again.
mcpDiagnostic.coreUnavailable: Keep MailX running and wait until its MCP server is ready, then check again.
mcpDiagnostic.bridgeUnavailable: The MailX bridge is unavailable. Check the app installation and repair the client configuration.
mcpDiagnostic.timeout: The connection check timed out. Try again after restarting the MCP server.
mcpDiagnostic.protocolError: The bridge could not complete the MCP handshake. Restart the server and check again.

mcpConflictDescription: This entry points to another MailX installation or data folder. Replacing it will connect this client to the current MailX. Other client settings will be kept.
mcpAgentHarnessHint: Add a stdio server in Harness settings, or copy this configuration for your personal Harness profile.
assistantAutoSummary: Summarize emails as you open them
assistantAutoSummaryDescription: Makes a summary when you open an email, except very short ones. Each one is sent to the model. You can also turn this on for a single sender from the summary panel.
assistantSummarySendersDescription: Mail from these addresses is always summarized when you open it. Add them from the summary panel in the reader.
assistantSummaryCacheDescription: Summaries are kept on this computer, so reopening an email shows its summary at once.
nowArrangementDescription: Automatic follows the time of day and what is in your mailbox. Fixed keeps the order you set.
nowModuleOrderHint: Drag or use the arrows to change the order.
nowReorderInstructions: Press Space or Enter to pick up a module, use the arrow keys to move it, then press Space or Enter to drop it. Press Escape to cancel.
